subject.title: feat(config): use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should timestamped config backups preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery points, or may the first post-upgrade cleanup prune them?
rationale: Config backups are recovery artifacts and can contain sensitive configuration, so changing retention and cleanup semantics for shipped backup files needs explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve legacy recovery points
options.body: Require the linked PR or replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the new timestamped retention set without silently deleting useful backups.

options.title: Accept timestamp-only cleanup
options.body: Allow the implementation to prune legacy numbered backups on first write, but document and prove that upgrade behavior as an intentional product tradeoff.

options.title: Keep numeric backups for now
options.body: Reject the naming change until maintainers choose a broader backup layout or recovery design.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy recovery points
recommendation.body: Require the linked PR or replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the new timestamped retention set without silently deleting useful backups.
